summary: Frontend-only verification of (a) intro letter-by-letter logo animation with 'Crafting Dreams' and (b) admin CMS media/founders upload workflow (logo + founders) without redeploy. All critical flows pass end-to-end: intro splits logo-full into 34 animated pieces (all visible by ~3.3s, intro closes ~3.8s), nav/footer/favicon render correct assets, admin upload returns /api/media/<id> and the public home reflects it after save, restore brings site back to /logo-mark.png default. Mobile 390px intro fits width (304px width, equal 42.9px margins). No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: LetterLogo.jsx uses canvas getImageData with crossOrigin=anonymous: when logoFull is served via /api/media/<id>, the backend must set Access-Control-Allow-Origin or canvas will taint and sliceLogo will throw (handled by fallback to plain motion.img — intro would still show but lose the letter-by-letter effect). Recommend verifying /api/media sets appropriate CORS headers so admin-uploaded logos keep the per-letter effect.
frontend/src/lib/intro.js evaluates SHOW_INTRO at module import time; works fine for session-storage first-visit scenario but could cause stale state in hot-reload dev scenarios (minor).
seed_data_creation: None. Uploaded a transparent PNG (copy of /app/frontend/public/logo-mark.png) to test the logoMark upload, then restored the field back to /logo-mark.png and saved so client content is unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Intro + CMS upload/restore flows verified. If backend /api/media is updated, re-verify that admin-uploaded logo retains the letter-by-letter effect (needs CORS on image response so canvas can read pixels; otherwise LetterLogo falls back to a single fade).
